templates.name: Release notes
templates.instructions: Write release notes from the supplied changes. Explain the user-visible benefits and any migration steps. Do not invent features or compatibility claims.

fields.label: Changes
fields.hint: Paste the changes included in this release.

fields.label: Migration steps
fields.hint: Describe breaking changes, upgrade steps, or known issues.

fields.label: Output format
fields.default: Markdown sections: Highlights, Changes, and Upgrading.
